items.settingsPath: Reinstall Microsoft News from the Store.
items.name: Microsoft News
items.desc: The Bing News app and its notification tasks.

items.settingsPath: Reinstall MSN Weather from the Store.
items.name: MSN Weather

items.settingsPath: Settings > Personalization > Taskbar, and turn Widgets back on. The package itself may need reinstalling from the Store.
items.name: Widgets board and Windows Web Experience Pack
items.desc: The panel, the taskbar button, and Win+W. Uninstalls the Windows Web Experience Pack, which is the package the whole feature ships in.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Personalization > Lock screen, and set it back to Windows spotlight.
items.name: Lock screen Spotlight ads
items.desc: Keeps the wallpapers, drops the ads, facts, and tips.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Personalization > Start, and turn the recommendations back on.
items.name: Start menu Recommended section
items.desc: Plus the app promotions that appear in it.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > General, and turn suggested content back on.
items.name: Settings page recommendations
items.desc: The upsell cards on the Settings home page.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Personalization > Start.
items.name: Account notifications in Start
items.desc: Removes the backup and Microsoft account prompts that appear above the power button.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: Finish setting up your device nag
items.desc: The full-screen prompt that appears after updates.

items.settingsPath: Settings > System > Notifications, and turn the Windows tips boxes back on.
items.name: Tips and suggestion notifications

items.settingsPath: Undo the run.
items.name: File Explorer banner ads
items.desc: Sync provider notifications, which is how Microsoft 365, and OneDrive advertise inside Explorer.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > General, and turn the advertising ID back on.
items.name: Advertising ID
items.desc: The per-user identifier used for ad personalization.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Search permissions, and turn search highlights back on.
items.name: Search highlights
items.desc: Sponsored content in taskbar and Start search. Sets the machine-wide policy alongside the per-user setting, so a feature update cannot turn it back on.

items.settingsPath: services.msc, find Connected User Experiences and Telemetry, and set it back to Automatic.
items.name: DiagTrack service
items.desc: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Diagnostics and feedback, and turn optional diagnostic data back on.
items.name: Diagnostic data to minimum
items.desc: Sets the lowest level the edition allows. Home and Pro cannot go as low as Enterprise.

items.settingsPath: Task Scheduler, or undo the run.
items.name: CEIP and Application Experience tasks
items.desc: Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater, Consolidator, UsbCeip, and KernelCeip.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Diagnostics and feedback, and set feedback frequency back to Automatically.
items.name: Feedback frequency to Never
items.desc: Plus the Siuf scheduled tasks.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > General, and turn tailored experiences back on.
items.name: Tailored experiences
items.desc: Using diagnostic data for personalized tips and ads.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Activity history, and turn it back on.
items.name: Activity history
items.desc: Local collection and cloud upload.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Inking and typing personalization, and turn it back on.
items.name: Inking, typing, and speech data
items.desc: Stops inking, typing, and speech data being sent for personalization.
items.riskNote: Stops sending typing and inking data to Microsoft. Autocorrect and text suggestions get slightly worse over time.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Location, and turn location services back on.
items.name: Location services
items.desc: System-wide location services.
items.riskNote: Breaks Find My Device, automatic time zone, and anything weather-related.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Delivery Optimization, and allow downloads from other PCs.
items.name: Delivery Optimization to LAN only
items.desc: Stops the machine seeding Windows updates to strangers over the internet.

items.settingsPath: services.msc, find Windows Error Reporting Service, and set it back to Manual.
items.name: Windows Error Reporting
items.desc: Windows Error Reporting.
items.riskNote: Some vendor support workflows read Windows Error Reporting logs when diagnosing a fault.

items.settingsPath: Reinstall Cortana from the Microsoft Store.
items.name: Cortana leftovers
items.desc: Residual packages, policies, and scheduled tasks.

items.settingsPath: Undo the run, or check edge://settings/privacy.
items.name: Edge telemetry and commerce
items.desc: Shopping, coupons, startup boost, background mode, and its telemetry.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Search permissions, and turn cloud content search back on.
items.name: Search and personalization tracking
items.desc: Turns off the language-list hand-off to websites, app-launch tracking in Start and search, and cloud search of your Microsoft and work accounts.

items.settingsPath: Settings > Privacy and security > Find my device, and turn it back on.
items.name: Find My Device location reporting
items.desc: Stops Windows periodically reporting the machine's location to your Microsoft account.
items.riskNote: If the machine is lost or stolen you will not be able to locate it from your Microsoft account. Nothing else depends on this.
